Cardiff Met Football Club, commonly known as Cardiff Met F.C., are a Welsh football club, based in Cyncoed, Cardiff that plays in the Cymru Premier. The club badge features the bowman with the words \"I lwyddo, rhaid chwarae\" which is translated as \"To succeed, [one] must play\".
